title: Dewards
tagline: One stop SDK integration for easy 'degen' rewarding
description: Number of events happen in a community and espasially in web3 ecosystem. After the event is complete there is no way engage users.
how_its_made:
Working this project was fun but also very challenging we ran into few issues listed below.
1. Signing transation with Biconomy. We solved this issue with the help of Biconomy's team.
2. Lack of developers. Our team only has 2 developers which restricted the scope of our working end project. We solved this by prioritizing features.
3. Internet issues. We used for hotspot and patiencance.
